text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph organization with an opening, supporting points, and a conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how clearly the writing is structured into a beginning, middle, and end with separate ideas developed across paragraphs."},{"evidence":"\"I can speak both Vietnamese and English\" \"I had a friend who is American\"","quality":"development","description":"This captures fuller elaboration of ideas with examples and personal details rather than a single brief statement."},{"evidence":"\"translate English to Vietnamese\" \"teach my friends\" \"communicate with others Vietnamese\"","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"This captures the use of longer, more varied sentences that combine multiple ideas and functions."},{"evidence":"\"don't you think it would be helpful\" \"I bet if you are from a foreign country\"","quality":"audience awareness","description":"This captures a more conversational, persuasive style that directly engages the reader."},{"evidence":"\"Vietnamese is on top 10 hardest language has spoken\" \"luckily I can speak Vietnamese\"","quality":"content control","description":"This captures stronger control of the topic through more specific and relevant supporting details."},{"evidence":"\"Hello\" \"police station\" \"family vacation\"","quality":"word choice","description":"This captures somewhat more precise vocabulary and more concrete terms for describing experiences."},{"evidence":"\"I asked them where is the police station\" \"what I was said\"","quality":"grammar control","description":"This captures somewhat better control of sentence grammar and verb forms even though errors remain frequent."}]}
